1. Engagement Scope

This document constitutes the final report for the 2001 annual HR compliance audit for American Foundation for Pay Equity. The scope encompassed a review of 321 policies and procedures, a sample of 34 personnel files, and interviews with 16 HR and payroll staff members.

2. Methodology

A statistical sampling approach was used to select {n} employee records for detailed testing. The sample size was calculated to provide a 95% confidence level with a 5% margin of error for projecting the error rate across the entire population.

4. Detailed Findings
CIH-1060-001LOWOPEN
Observation

Mandatory anti-harassment training not completed by 4% of managers in 16 as required by state law

Corrective Action Required

The company shall engage a third-party firm to conduct an independent, privileged assessment of its corporate safety culture, focusing on leadership commitment, employee involvement, and hazard identification.

Management Response

The finding is acknowledged. A cross-functional task force has been assembled to address the root cause. An initial project plan and timeline will be submitted to ACPWB within 15 days.

Owner: Senior Manager of Project Management • Due: 2001-08-28
CIH-9087-002INFORMATIONALDEFERRED
Observation

Commission plan agreements for 321 sales employees are not in writing as required by state law

Corrective Action Required

Develop and distribute a manager and HR guide on USERRA reemployment rights and obligations. Conduct mandatory training for all hiring managers and HR business partners.

Management Response

This finding has been remediated as of the report date. Supporting documentation, including revised policy language and employee acknowledgment records, has been provided to ACPWB under separate cover. American Foundation for Pay Equity requests formal closure of this item.

Owner: Grant Writer • Due: 2001-08-28
CIH-4096-003MEDIUMREMEDIATED
Observation

SOX 302 sub-certification process for HR controls is not consistently documented or retained

Corrective Action Required

Implement a centralized job classification review process with documented approval workflow. All reclassification decisions must be signed off by the designated owner and retained for a minimum of 3 years per applicable recordkeeping requirements.

Management Response

Management has reviewed the finding and determined that the current practice, while inconsistent with the recommendation, is based on a reasonable interpretation of an ambiguous regulation. We will continue to monitor regulatory developments but plan no immediate changes.

Owner: Director of Technology Operations • Due: 2001-07-28
CIH-7162-004INFORMATIONALOPEN
Observation

OSHA 300A summary not certified by a company executive for 16 establishments

Corrective Action Required

Immediately cease all inquiries into candidate salary history during the hiring process. Update all recruiter training materials and interview guides to reflect this prohibition.

Management Response

The finding is accepted. The required training has been developed and assigned to all 321 affected employees with a mandatory completion date of 2001-05-05. Completion rates will be tracked and reported to the compliance department.

Owner: Chief Risk Officer • Due: 2001-06-28
